note_horizon: Observational censoring at 72h; no time exit added to primary live strategy.
historical_universe: All archived USDT UM symbols with data in window; known non-crypto/stable bases excluded; point-in-time metadata limitations reported, not silently assumed solved.
controls: same-event hashed random direction preserving initial stop distance
4h-trend aligned hashed random timing, fixed selection rate 0.05
uncertainty: UTC-entry-day and week block bootstrap; long/short separately; no guaranteed sample size
robustness: exclude top 3 symbols by total net R
claim_gate: No live-profitability or holdout claim from this exploratory archive run.
gap_policy: Targeted repair; after 30 minutes keep missing path explicitly unresolved. No invented stop, no automatic -1R for cancellations. Portfolio entries remain paused if capital unresolved; independent observation lane continues.
coverage: Count universe, attempted, valid, setups, admitted, entered, cancelled, closed, unresolved separately. Flag coverage <0.95 without changing strategy admission threshold.
auxiliary_fields: BTC 4h trend agreement; all observational only
funding: Historical rate with contemporaneous archived mark-price bar estimate; missing rate/price is unresolved, never zero-filled.
archive_checks: Checksum verify every zip, explicit missing files and continuity issues. No REST requests while known cooldown active.
